definicoes.idioma_aviso: The language applies when Kikoia restarts.
definicoes.arranque_opcao: Start the keyboard with the computer
definicoes.arranque_dica: Starts the keyboard when Windows or Linux starts, for your user account.
definicoes.telemovel_opcao: Connect to the phone automatically at startup (5 min)
definicoes.telemovel_dica: When the computer starts, the keyboard waits 5 minutes for your trusted phone, without asking for a code.
atualizacoes.nao_configurado: Update checks are not set up for this keyboard yet.
atualizacoes.confirmar: Update {quantidade} package(s)? Restart the keyboard afterwards.
atualizacoes.atualizado: Update complete. Restart the keyboard to use the new versions.
atualizacoes.falhou: Could not update. See the error log.
janela.teclado_fisico_dica: The program watches the keys to suggest words
telemovel.tempo_esgotado: Waiting time is over. To connect the phone, open Phone on the computer.
telemovel.emparelhado: Phone paired ({endereco}). Next time no code is needed.
geral.nao_aprovado: The change was not approved. The adult's code is needed when supervision is on.
gateway.ajuda_1: On the phone, open Kikoia, find the computer and type the code above.
gateway.ajuda_2: The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi network. If Windows asks for network permission, accept it.
gateway.ajuda_3: If the port is blocked by the network (schools, public networks), connecting will not be possible.
gateway.desligue_primeiro: Turn it off first to change the port.
gateway.desligado: Off. Turn it on to pair a phone.
gateway.dica_bluetooth: Use the Bluetooth of the phone paired with this computer.
gateway.usado: Code already used. To connect another phone, generate a new code.
gateway.expirado: Code expired or used up. Generate a new code.
gateway.ligados: Phone connected ({n}). You can use the keyboard.
dialogos.imagem_erro: This image could not be opened.
voz.ler_frase: Read the sentence at the end (. ! ? or Enter)
voz.ler_sugestao: Read the suggested word when chosen
voz.sem_vozes_1: No voices were found. You can install more voices in the
voz.sem_vozes_2: Windows Speech settings (including Portuguese from Portugal).
editor.tecla_dica: Type the letters in order. Each repeated tap on the key changes the letter.
editor.atalho: Make it a shortcut key (to go to this keyboard from others)
editor.tecla_programa_dica: Key that opens a program or runs a command on the PC
editor.passo_1_a: 1. Your keyboard — click a key to select it,
editor.passo_1_b: or on a + to add the key chosen in the list below.
editor.passo_2: 2. Available keys — choose one, then click a + on the keyboard.
editor.acrescentar_dica: Add the chosen key to this row
editor.vazio: There are no keys yet. Choose a quick model above, or click «+ New row».
editor.primeiro_escolha: First choose a key in the list below, then click «+».
editor.escreva_simbolo: Type the letter or symbol (up to 20 characters):
editor.programa_nao_configurado: Creating program keys is not set up.
editor.so_apagar_1: You can only delete keyboards you created (project models cannot be deleted).
editor.so_apagar_2: If supervision is on, the adult's code is needed.
editor.linha_criada: Row {n} created. Click its «+» to add keys.
editor.apagar_linha_pergunta: Delete row {n} and all its keys?
editor.escolhida: Chosen: «{rotulo}». Click a «+» on a row to place it.
editor.tecla_criada: Key «{rotulo}» created. Click a «+» on a row to place it.
editor.substituir_pergunta: Replace the current keys with the «{nome}» model?
editor.modelo_carregado: Model «{nome}» loaded. You can change it and then save under another name if you like.
sup.ativa: Supervision is on: the changes below need the adult's code.
sup.desligada_1: Supervision is off. With supervision on, the child cannot change
sup.desligada_2: the settings without the adult's code.
sup.novo_codigo: New code (empty = keep the current one)
sup.desativar_pergunta: Turn off supervision? The code will no longer be needed to change the settings.
sup.nao_coincidem: The two codes do not match.
ia.chave_placeholder: Free key (kept only on this computer)
ia.descreva: Describe the keyboard and click «Generate preview».
ia.a_pedir: Asking the AI for the keyboard…
ia.verifique: Check the preview. If it is right, click «Use this keyboard».
cmd.explica_1: These keys run programs on the PC. Once created, you can place them on any
cmd.explica_2: keyboard in the keyboard editor and also use them from the phone.
cmd.ajuda_1: Enter the full path of the program, for example
cmd.ajuda_2: C:\Program Files\Notepad++\notepad++.exe, or a command such as calc.
cmd.ajuda_3: You can add arguments. You can also choose a file, which is opened with the
tecladofisico.mostrar: Show suggestions when typing on the physical keyboard
tecladofisico.aprender: Learn the words I type on the physical keyboard
tecladofisico.confirmar_1: Turn on suggestions with the physical keyboard? The program will start watching
tecladofisico.confirmar_2: the keys you press (without keeping a record of them).
tecladofisico.explicacao_2: When on, word suggestions also appear while you type with the
tecladofisico.explicacao_4: To do this, the program watches the keys you press. It does not keep a record of the
tecladofisico.explicacao_5: keys: it only keeps the word you are typing and forgets it when it ends
tecladofisico.explicacao_7: A red indicator ● Physical keyboard appears whenever it is on.
bluetooth.instalar: Install the winrt-Windows.Devices.Bluetooth.Rfcomm packages and related ones.
bluetooth.sem_bluez: Bluetooth unavailable: the BlueZ service is not running or there is no Bluetooth adapter.
sup.codigo_pelo_menos: The code must have at least {n} characters.
voz.modelo_em_falta: The voice model for this language is missing. Download it in «Voice options».
voz.sem_modelo_idioma: There is no voice model for this language yet.
voz.modelo_nao_instalado: Voice model not installed. It is downloaded only if you ask for it, to dictate.
voz.confirmar_descarga: Download the voice model (≈{mb} MB)? It is only used for dictation.
voz.modelo_instalado_ok: Model installed. Dictation can now be turned on.
definicoes.idioma_reiniciar: To apply the language, Kikoia must restart. Restart now?
